source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 1
2. Set Health-Monitor via cmd: dcgmi health -s mpi
3. Check Health-Monitor via cmd: dcgmi health -c
4. Run Health-Test L2 via cmd: dcgmi diag -v -r 2
5. Disable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 0

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Health-Monitor should show "Healthy".
2. The result of Health-Test L2 should be PASS without errors.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Full level-2 output emphasizing PCIe checks.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES but incomplete; omits monitor/persistence workflow and assumes alternate diagnostic syntax/coverage.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds DCGM compatibility, PCIe topology/policy, workload window, baseline and restoration.

original_test_intent: Configure and verify the requested DCGM health monitor, run the complete Level-2 diagnostic including its PCIe checks on all approved GPUs, and restore safe persistence/monitor state.
original_method: Validate DCGM/GPU/PCIe topology and baseline, run the exact persistence enable, `health -s mpi`, `health -c`, and verbose run-level-2 sequence under one approved plan, retain full PCIe diagnostic details, then disable or restore persistence and monitor settings as approved.
manual_activity: One authorized user approves the unchanged setup/L2/restoration plan. All core commands and evidence collection are machine-executable, so package and approval do not make the case PARTIAL.
required_inputs: Approved DCGM/dcgmi, driver and GPU target map
GPU PCI BDF/slot/upstream topology with expected link capability/state
Deployed meaning of `mpi` health watches and exact L2 syntax/coverage
Workload/traffic window and persistence/monitor baseline/final state
safety_requirements: Verify stable GPUs, PCIe topology, tool semantics and workload safety before state changes.
One approval covers the fixed plan; stop on deviation, partial setup, PCIe/driver error or device loss.
Run exactly approved L2 and preserve full per-test/PCIe output, warnings and return codes.
Restore approved final state and never clear PCIe counters, reset GPUs or retrain links automatically.
No automatic diagnostic retry or service/driver restart.
agent_execution_scope: Collect DCGM/GPU/PCIe/baseline/workload evidence and verify plan gates.
Execute the full source monitor/persistence workflow and verbose L2 diagnostic.
Compare PCIe observations with the approved topology policy, restore final state and collect OS/BMC events.
Report DCGM Tool Result and deviations without formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve tools, topology/policy, targets, workload window, changes and restoration.
Resolve abnormal PCIe result or tool-version semantic issue.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its level-2-only command may be a version alias but omits the source monitor/persistence coverage and does not prove PCIe expectations without topology evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve all source commands including `dcgmi diag -v -r 2`; accept alternate syntax only with versioned help and equivalent test coverage.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All five steps, `mpi`, verbose run level 2, criteria, script URL and 2/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: SOURCE L2 WORKFLOW RETAINED WITH PCIE CORRELATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a stable per-GPU/DCGM-ID transaction and correlate the full L2 PCIe report with lspci topology/link state plus baseline/final monitor and persistence evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: DCGM-supported NVIDIA GPUs and project PCIe topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record DCGM/dcgmi, driver, GPU firmware, nvidia-smi, pciutils, BIOS and OS/kernel.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA DCGM diagnostics/health documentation for the deployed release, pciutils evidence and referenced project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds topology, stable identity, workload and restoration controls without dropping source steps.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; Healthy monitor and full L2 PASS remain required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: DCGM L2 PASS is tool evidence and does not by itself prove every platform-specific bandwidth or workload requirement.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve equivalent version-specific syntax or scoped GPUs, but must state coverage and cannot generalize reduced targets or a shorthand diagnostic to the master case.
expected_evidence: DCGM/driver/pciutils versions, stable GPU/DCGM/BDF/slot topology and baseline
Complete persistence and health-watch setup/check output
Full verbose L2 report with per-test PCIe details and return code
Expected topology comparison, final restoration and OS/BMC/driver health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently require monitor Healthy and Level-2 PASS. Missing platform PCIe expectations are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The workflow is explicit and automatable after tool/topology/plan inputs; it is not permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Restores all omitted source steps and requires topology evidence beyond generic PCIe PASS wording.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains compatibility, PCIe, workload, baseline and restoration controls while correcting V3.1 classification to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Applies one-plan approval, no retry and separates DCGM PASS from engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a standalone L2 summary from replacing the health-monitor workflow or hiding wrong/degraded PCIe topology.
independent_technical_reasoning: Every required operation uses software interfaces; no physical setup or human observation is inherent. Risk and approval affect readiness, not automation capability.
